nodes.name: Receive eBay Notification (POST)
nodes.notes: Actual MARKETPLACE_ACCOUNT_DELETION notifications land here. This app only uses eBay's Browse API via client_credentials (no user OAuth, no eBay user PII stored), so there's nothing to delete — this just acknowledges receipt so eBay's compliance check passes. Signature verification (X-EBAY-SIGNATURE) is skipped for that reason; add it if this app ever stores eBay user data tied to buyer/seller accounts.

nodes.name: Respond Ack
nodes.notes: 204 No Content — matches eBay's own reference SDK behavior on successful processing.
